dialogues.jp: 郵便受けを覗き込んで新聞をとりだす。
dialogues.en: I looked into the mailbox and pulled the newspaper out.
dialogues.text: I looked into the mailbox and pulled the newspaper out.

dialogues.jp:
空になった確認に手をさしこんで、端から端ま
でざっと動かした。
dialogues.en:
I then searched around inside the mailbox to see if anything
else was in it.
dialogues.text:
I then searched around inside the mailbox to see if anything
else was in it.

dialogues.jp: 杉並の言っていた通知はまだ届いていない。
dialogues.en: I didn't get the notice letter Suginami was talking about.
dialogues.text: I didn't get the notice letter Suginami was talking about.

dialogues.jp:
「本気で、これがグッキリカメラかなにかだっ
　たらな」
dialogues.en: "I wish this was a candid camera or something."
dialogues.text: "I wish this was a candid camera or something."

dialogues.jp:
杉並が、医者と学園の理事達の判子を偽造した
文書を送りつけてきてくれれば……。
dialogues.en:
What if Suginami wrote the letter and faked the principal's
and the doctor's signature and sent it to us......
dialogues.text:
What if Suginami wrote the letter and faked the principal's
and the doctor's signature and sent it to us......

dialogues.jp:
「そうすれば、あのバカを殴り倒して終わりな
　んだが」
dialogues.en:
"Then I could just punch that idiot and that would be the
end of it......"
dialogues.text:
"Then I could just punch that idiot and that would be the
end of it......"

dialogues.jp:
あいつがそういう冗談をしないことだけは、悔
しいことに長年の付き合いで知っている。
dialogues.en: It's too bad that even he wouldn't do something like that.
dialogues.text: It's too bad that even he wouldn't do something like that.

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、子供が生まれました――という絵葉書
を去年送ってきていたが……。
dialogues.en:
Although he did sent a postcard saying he had a baby last
year......
dialogues.text:
Although he did sent a postcard saying he had a baby last
year......

dialogues.jp:
爽やかな春の朝日とは対照的に、俺は肩を落と
して地面を見つめた。
dialogues.en:
My shoulders drooped and I looked down at the ground, even
though it was a nice spring day.
dialogues.text:
My shoulders drooped and I looked down at the ground, even
though it was a nice spring day.

dialogues.jp: まだ音夢の目は覚めず。
dialogues.en: Nemu's still sleeping.
dialogues.text: Nemu's still sleeping.

dialogues.jp: まだ時間は動かない。
dialogues.en: It's like time has been stopped.
dialogues.text: It's like time has been stopped.

dialogues.jp: 「自宅療養か……」
dialogues.en: "Recuperate at home......"
dialogues.text: "Recuperate at home......"

dialogues.jp:
早く音夢におはよう、と言ってもらいたいのに、
俺から音夢にかける言葉のなんて冷たいことか。
dialogues.en:
I want Nemu to say good morning to me, but I don't have good
news for her...
dialogues.text:
I want Nemu to say good morning to me, but I don't have good
news for her...

dialogues.jp:
今の段階だと、起きて欲しいのか、眠ったまま
でいて欲しいのかがごっちゃになっている。
dialogues.en:
I don't know if I want her to wake up or stay sleeping at
the moment.
dialogues.text:
I don't know if I want her to wake up or stay sleeping at
the moment.

dialogues.jp: 「あー、あれだ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, that!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, that!"

dialogues.jp:
昔、テストで悪い点をとってしまい、それを親
に見せるのが嫌で仕方なかった時と同じだ。
dialogues.en:
It feels like the time I had bad grades and didn't want to
show it to my parents.
dialogues.text:
It feels like the time I had bad grades and didn't want to
show it to my parents.

dialogues.jp:
そんな面倒でかったるいときだけ、時間はゆっ
くりと流れる。
dialogues.en: Time slows down during the worst moments of your life.
dialogues.text: Time slows down during the worst moments of your life.

dialogues.jp: 「……上手くいかないもんだな」
dialogues.en: "What a pain......"
dialogues.text: "What a pain......"

dialogues.jp: はぁ……と、もう一度ため息をついて家に戻る。
dialogues.en: I sighed again and went back inside.
dialogues.text: I sighed again and went back inside.

dialogues.jp: 「かったるい、かったるい、かった――」
dialogues.en: "Shit, shit, shit......"
dialogues.text: "Shit, shit, shit......"

dialogues.jp: 居間に入って足が止まった。
dialogues.en: I stopped as I walked into the living room.
dialogues.text: I stopped as I walked into the living room.

dialogues.jp:
制服姿の音夢がぼーっ、と開けたままの冷蔵庫
を前にして立ち尽くしている。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was standing in front of the refrigerator in her school
uniform.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was standing in front of the refrigerator in her school
uniform.

dialogues.jp: 音夢がゆっくりと振り返る。
dialogues.en: Nemu turned around slowly.
dialogues.text: Nemu turned around slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん……」
dialogues.en: "Niisan......"
dialogues.text: "Niisan......"

dialogues.jp: 思わず新聞を取り落としそうになる。
dialogues.en: I almost dropped my newspapers.
dialogues.text: I almost dropped my newspapers.

dialogues.jp:
音夢はよろよろ、と俺の胸元に倒れこみ、涙で
揺れる瞳を上げた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu wobbled into my arms and looked at me with tears in her
eyes.
dialogues.text:
Nemu wobbled into my arms and looked at me with tears in her
eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫か！？」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん……ごめん、私……ダメ……」
dialogues.en: "Niisan...... I'm sorry...... I can't......"
dialogues.text: "Niisan...... I'm sorry...... I can't......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢！」
dialogues.en: "Nemu!"
dialogues.text: "Nemu!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お腹すいたよぉ〜」
dialogues.en: "I'm starving..."
dialogues.text: "I'm starving..."

dialogues.jp: ……グゥ。
dialogues.en: Her stomach rumbled.
dialogues.text: Her stomach rumbled.

dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お腹ペコペコだよ〜、なんか作って〜」
dialogues.en: "I'm so hungry. Can you make something?"
dialogues.text: "I'm so hungry. Can you make something?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あれ？　どうしたの兄さん、プルプル震
　えちゃって？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? What happened? You're shaking?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? What happened? You're shaking?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん？　兄さ〜ん？　立ったまま寝てる
　の？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan? Niisan?? Are you sleeping standing up?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan? Niisan?? Are you sleeping standing up?"

dialogues.jp: ぼけ倒す音夢を見下ろす。
dialogues.en: I looked down at Nemu.
dialogues.text: I looked down at Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんかすっごくお腹すいちゃって……えへへ、
　昨日の兄さんとのキスがよっぽど激しかった
　んだね」
dialogues.en:
"Do you get really hungry like this the day after you do
that kind of thing?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you get really hungry like this the day after you do
that kind of thing?"

dialogues.jp: どんなキスだ、どんな……って、昨日？
dialogues.en: Day after?
dialogues.text: Day after?

dialogues.jp: 「あのさ……お前、制服来てどこに行くんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, where do you think you're going with your uniform on?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, where do you think you're going with your uniform on?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「え、学園に決まってるでしょうが。ボケちゃっ
　たの兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "School, of course. What's wrong with you?"
dialogues.text: "School, of course. What's wrong with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ……もしかして……もうふたりのラブラブっ
　ぷりに、ボケボケしちゃってるの？」
dialogues.en: "Do guys act like that after you do that kind of thing?"
dialogues.text: "Do guys act like that after you do that kind of thing?"

dialogues.jp: あぁ、そうか。
dialogues.en: I see...
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.jp: こいつ、今日が２２日だと思っているのか。
dialogues.en: She still thinks it's the 22nd.
dialogues.text: She still thinks it's the 22nd.

dialogues.jp:
「あのな、さっき美春から電話があって、今日
　の委員会の仕事は休みになったってさ」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, Miharu called just now and she said the school
committee work has been cancelled today."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, Miharu called just now and she said the school
committee work has been cancelled today."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「え、そうなの！？　……私のせいじゃないよ
　ね」
dialogues.en: "Really? It's not because of me, is it?"
dialogues.text: "Really? It's not because of me, is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「違うって。飯を作ってやるから、落ち着いて
　ソファーにでも座ってろ」
dialogues.en: "No. Sit down on the sofa. I'll make you something to eat."
dialogues.text: "No. Sit down on the sofa. I'll make you something to eat."

dialogues.jp: 髪をくしゃ、っとなでて笑う。
dialogues.en: I touched her hair and smiled.
dialogues.text: I touched her hair and smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん♪　うわ、なんか良い事尽くめ♪」
dialogues.en: "Okay. It seems like a great start to the day."
dialogues.text: "Okay. It seems like a great start to the day."

dialogues.jp:
俺の手をとったまま、音夢がソファーに腰掛け
る。
dialogues.en: She took my hand and sat on the sofa.
dialogues.text: She took my hand and sat on the sofa.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、兄さん……朝の挨拶」
dialogues.en: "Oh, the morning ritual, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Oh, the morning ritual, niisan."

dialogues.jp:
そっ、と音夢の指が俺の腕をのぼって頬に触れ
る。
dialogues.en: She reached her fingers out to my cheek.
dialogues.text: She reached her fingers out to my cheek.

dialogues.jp: 思わず見詰め合ってしまう。
dialogues.en: We couldn't help staring at each other.
dialogues.text: We couldn't help staring at each other.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふたりの新しい朝だね」
dialogues.en: "It's a new beginning for us."
dialogues.text: "It's a new beginning for us."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんだか新婚さんみたい……って、ふふ、そ
　のまんまかな？」
dialogues.en: "It feels like being newlyweds...... are we doing too much?"
dialogues.text: "It feels like being newlyweds...... are we doing too much?"

dialogues.jp: 愛しくて、強く強く音夢を抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: I held Nemu really tight because she was so sweet.
dialogues.text: I held Nemu really tight because she was so sweet.

dialogues.jp: 一瞬。
dialogues.en: At this moment...
dialogues.text: At this moment...

dialogues.jp: 夢かと思ってしまった。
dialogues.en: I thought that last night was a dream.
dialogues.text: I thought that last night was a dream.

dialogues.jp:
杉並やさくらと話していたことが全て夢で……
俺が寝ぼけているのではないかと。
dialogues.en:
Everything Sakura and Suginami were talking about was a
dream and I was still sleeping.
dialogues.text:
Everything Sakura and Suginami were talking about was a
dream and I was still sleeping.

dialogues.jp: けれど、多分……その考えこそ夢だ。
dialogues.en: But, in real life... those thoughts are the only dream.
dialogues.text: But, in real life... those thoughts are the only dream.

dialogues.jp: 夢。
dialogues.en: A dream.
dialogues.text: A dream.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「っ……兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんかおかしいよ……泣きそう？」
dialogues.en: "You look different...... Are you crying?"
dialogues.text: "You look different...... Are you crying?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: "Do I look different?"
dialogues.text: "Do I look different?"

dialogues.jp: 頬と目の奥が熱いのを自覚しながら微笑む。
dialogues.en: I felt tears in the back of my eyes but smiled.
dialogues.text: I felt tears in the back of my eyes but smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、うん……なんとなくだけど」
dialogues.en: "Maybe...... I'm not sure."
dialogues.text: "Maybe...... I'm not sure."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「幸せだから……だろう」
dialogues.en: "It's because I'm happy."
dialogues.text: "It's because I'm happy."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うん」
目を細めて、本当に嬉しそうに音夢が笑う。
dialogues.en: Nemu narrowed her eyes and smiled happily.
dialogues.text: Nemu narrowed her eyes and smiled happily.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふふふ……分かってきたね兄さん」
dialogues.en: "You're getting the hang of it, Niisan."
dialogues.text: "You're getting the hang of it, Niisan."

dialogues.jp: これは夢じゃない……。
dialogues.en: This isn't a dream......
dialogues.text: This isn't a dream......

dialogues.jp: 夢じゃないと分かっているのに。
dialogues.en: I knew it wasn't a dream.
dialogues.text: I knew it wasn't a dream.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「夢みたい、だね」
dialogues.en: "It's just like a dream."
dialogues.text: "It's just like a dream."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の笑顔が俺に｛ささや／囁｝きかけてくる。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled and whispered to me.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled and whispered to me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「こんな夢なら……ずっと見てたいよね？」
dialogues.en: "I want to stay in this dream, if it's really a dream."
dialogues.text: "I want to stay in this dream, if it's really a dream."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ――お兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "Don't you think, Oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you think, Oniichan?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は――。
dialogues.en: As far as I'm concerned......
dialogues.text: As far as I'm concerned......

dialogues.jp: ◆幸せな夢の誘惑◆
dialogues.en: ◆Temptation of a happy dream◆
dialogues.text: ◆Temptation of a happy dream◆

dialogues.jp:
体調が悪くなっていたと思われた音夢だが、元
気な姿で居間に現れる。
dialogues.en:
I thought Nemu was very sick but she came down to the living
room looking healthy.
dialogues.text:
I thought Nemu was very sick but she came down to the living
room looking healthy.

dialogues.jp:
幸せだね、こんな夢みたいなことが続けばいい
のにね――と微笑む音夢。
dialogues.en:
Nemu smiled and said she's really happy and it feels like a
dream.
dialogues.text:
Nemu smiled and said she's really happy and it feels like a
dream.

dialogues.jp:
なぜだか違和感を憶えたが、確かにこんなに幸
せな夢ならば――。
dialogues.en: It felt weird, but it does seem like a happy dream......
dialogues.text: It felt weird, but it does seem like a happy dream......
